rows.text: computes n = (`r8d` + 15) / 16 (signed) and, when `r8d` is non-zero and qword `02F8F2D0` + n times 16 is at or above qword `02F8F2D8` (unsigned), returns without writing; otherwise takes 0x28-byte record (word `02F8F2C6`) of the array at qword `02F8F2F8`, increments that word, and stores in the record qword `02F8F2D0` at `+0`, the fifth (stack) argument at dword `+8`, `r9b` at byte `+0xB`, `r8d` at dword `+0xC`, `rcx` at qword `+0x10` and, at dword `+0x20`, (dword `02AEF41C` times 2, OR 1 when the call at `003A2C80` + 0x8E returns non-zero or dword `02AEF418` is non-zero) times 2; when `r8d` is non-zero it then makes the call at + 0xD2 with qword `02F8F2D0`, `rdx` and n times 16, and adds n times 16 to qword `02F8F2D0`
when bit 4 (0x10) of byte `rcx+0x244` is set, makes the call at `00504700` + 0x1A with (`rcx`, 1, 1); in both cases then tail-jumps at + 0x2E to the same callee with (`rcx`, 1, 0)
